narrativeText.english: You stand before two doors. The left door is made of solid oak, reinforced with iron. The right door is a shimmering, unstable portal of green energy.

As you step through the portal, your body is instantly disintegrated by raw magic. Your atoms are scattered across the dimensions.

Your life and your mission end here.

The door opens into a dark room. A swinging axe blade flies from the ceiling and strikes you a glancing blow before you can react. You lose 15 ENDURANCE points. If your ENDURANCE is now 0 or less, you have bled to death.

choiceText.english: If you survive, you continue into the darkness.
